contractBinding.note: Expected references only. Neither canonical D/P schemas nor U01 full-response fixtures are defined here. A must reconcile names and freeze schemas before fixture/component binding.

customerIntent: Fictional Contoso Insurance must prepare digital claims for its customer-confirmed seasonal deadline: protect sensitive claims documents, retain approved US geography, recover within 60 minutes, and keep the defined estimated workload cost within USD 8,000/month.
wordingConstraints: RPO starts null/unconfirmed. Ask the consequential question; 15 minutes is an authored mock answer, never automatic live confirmation.

A is a synthetic USD 6,000/month example and ineligible: the approved regional-loss recovery profile is absent. B is synthetic USD 7,200/month, eligible and lowest-cost eligible. UI displays server verdicts, not a client price/rule calculation.
Do not compare ineligible A with B as savings. Recovery-design support is not runtime recovery-test proof; estimated cost is not billing.

CP-01 concerns approved private claims-storage connectivity, public network disabled and genuine private-path evidence. Missing binding/path evidence is unknown; an observed failed property is breached.
Desired publicNetworkAccess is Disabled. The separately authorized safe empty-sandbox seed is Enabled, with anonymous access still disabled. Resource scope is operator-bound, not invented here.
Restore the exact approved desired-state hash and verify CP-01 afresh. Runtime-only correction may add a non-executable descriptor while leaving approved Bicep unchanged.
Other promises without adequate evidence remain unknown. No fixed 7/8 or 8/8 success count.
Implementation Materialized means local files only. Azure deployed and Runtime verified are separate evidence-backed facts.
Show fixture origin and Demo Identity/local-demo limitation. This design proves no live execution or approval.

moments.label: Promise
moments.customerImpact: Agree what protecting claimants and meeting the seasonal deadline requires before work proceeds.

moments.label: Decision
moments.customerImpact: See why the cheaper design fails mandatory recovery and what the eligible choice authorizes.

moments.label: Implementation Prepared / Approved / Materialized
moments.customerImpact: Inspect exactly what will change locally; do not mistake prepared files for protected runtime claims.

moments.label: Promise At Risk
moments.customerImpact: Sensitive claims-storage connectivity no longer matches the approved private boundary. Show the exact broken edge and the next required decision.

moments.label: Proof
moments.customerImpact: Distinguish fresh scoped restoration from unknown promises, and disclose delivery, evidence and all human effort.

interactionIndexNote: UX-I-01..18 are stable design coverage IDs for the grouped experiences in implementation sections 7.5 and 10.2, not new backend action IDs.

interactions.name: Define and confirm customer promise
interactions.acceptance: Customer impact precedes controls; unconfirmed criteria remain visible.

interactions.name: Answer consequential RPO question
interactions.acceptance: Explicit 15-minute mock answer; no automatic confirmation or hidden question.

interactions.name: Compare rejected and eligible options
interactions.acceptance: A rejection reason and B eligibility remain legible; never force two eligible choices.

interactions.name: Approve exact design and see generation progress
interactions.acceptance: Expose subject/version/hash, scope and local-demo identity; generation progress is not success.

interactions.name: Review prepared and validated files
interactions.acceptance: Implementation Prepared includes location, bounded diff and validation; approval is still separate.

interactions.name: Approve local delivery
interactions.acceptance: Implementation Approved is not locally applied; explicit Materialize remains necessary.

interactions.name: Materialize locally and inspect separate Azure binding
interactions.acceptance: Applying and Implementation Materialized are distinct; Azure acknowledgement cannot be inferred from local bytes.

interactions.name: Understand proactive risk and exact lineage
interactions.acceptance: Risk arrives from a mock observation example, not Scan; graph and ordered list show identical supported edges and gaps.

interactions.name: Resume with While You Were Away
interactions.acceptance: Completed, failed and still-pending work stay distinct; reading does not approve or mark seen.

interactions.name: Inspect Human Attention
interactions.acceptance: Product Human Attention and Demo/Test Operator Actions are separate; unavailable duration is not zero.

interactions.name: Review and authorize bounded correction in distinct steps
interactions.acceptance: Separate material approval, local delivery approval and Materialize; unchanged Bicep is honest for runtime-only drift.

interactions.name: Wait for separately authorized runtime restoration
interactions.acceptance: Local materialization leaves verification pending; operator consent and fresh evidence are not product approvals.

interactions.name: Inspect verified restoration and remaining unknowns
interactions.acceptance: Only authored fresh scoped CP-01 proof is illustrated; all unsupported promises remain unknown.

interactions.name: Read or export the three-question receipt
interactions.acceptance: Did we keep the promise? Did we deliver? What value did we create? UI and future JSON/Markdown snapshot must agree.

interactions.name: Inspect qualified evidence and return
interactions.acceptance: Show origin, observed time, resource, supported promise, freshness and limitations before technical expansion.

interactions.name: Start from empty and understand loading
interactions.acceptance: Empty explains absence; loading is pending work, never completion.

interactions.name: Recover safely from stale, blocked and failed states
interactions.acceptance: Expose blocker/diagnostic/correlation ID and server-permitted recovery; no stale or failed apply.

interactions.name: Reconnect and retain accessible operation
interactions.acceptance: Reload current projection without repeating mutations; keyboard, narrow and zoom journeys preserve all actions.

states.label: Implementation Materialized / Azure binding pending / Runtime unknown
Mock Azure baseline acknowledged / mock scoped evidence separate
Mock restoration acknowledged / fresh verification pending
Mock fresh scoped restoration / other promises unknown
Blocked: permission / gate / missing binding or evidence
Evidence: fresh / stale / partial / fixture / replayed

sharedVariants.acceptance: Pending work text; disable duplicate submit; polite meaningful updates, no token spam.
Display server reason and allowed recovery; no client-created authority.
Only server-issued retry; reconnect never silently repeats a mutation.
One narrow layout stacks cards, uses ordered lineage and per-file diff; drawer fills viewport.
All actions keyboard accessible; focus visible and restored; errors lead to labelled fields.
200% zoom preserves reading order, labels and actions without overlap.
Respect reduced motion; no meaning depends on animation or color alone.

storyboardBoundary: illustrativeNextStateId is a design walkthrough reference, not executable transitions or permission logic. Async/operator examples require separately authored full responses. Builders must use server-issued allowedActions; the UI never computes eligibility, approval, coverage or verification.
